text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
~♪ How long has it been
since I last ate Mother's cookies?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Shall we brew some tea first?
If I recall, we still have some of that gift left—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah... ah... ah...
M-Mother's cookies... they broke...!
